bootstrap.multiplicity: Two primary contrasts use Bonferroni 97.5-percent two-sided intervals; all component/tier/domain breakdowns are exploratory.

cluster_key: cross-tier query_idx from the frozen media roster

decision.adoption: Same-roster full comparison reproduction required before claiming a newly effective mechanism.
decision.effect_threshold_proportion: min(0.01, 0.10 * max(0, published equal-tier exact_match - comparator equal-tier exact_match))
decision.knowledge_contribution: The corresponding knowledge-minus-stage-control primary lower bound exceeds its predeclared threshold under natural and equal-tier weighting.
decision.negative_or_uncertain: Report each comparison separately; no positive memory rule or new roster is inferred. Name a component from predeclared traces before another mechanism is admitted.
decision.promising_system: Knowledge-minus-direct primary lower bound exceeds the predeclared headroom threshold under natural and equal-tier weighting. Require nonnegative official tool-accuracy and macro parameter-F1 point differences; these latter checks do not establish noninferiority.

paper_reference.role: Published ceiling reference for headroom target; not a mathematical upper bound or matched model/population.

read_policy: All three complete manifests must seal before root semantic task-result inspection. Each official complete score runs once with per-sample statistics. No dropped long rows, parser gaming or outcome-based rule choice.
